problem.title: Circular industry-strength reward
confirmedCurrentPaths: SECTOR_HARD_GATE: candidate contributes to same-day breadth, avgChange and amountVs20DayAverage used to admit itself.
SECTOR_RANK_SCORE: candidate contributes to sector.score, which contributes 14% of priorityScore.
HISTORY_WARMUP_PRIORITY: candidate contributes to sector.score, which contributes to coarseWarmupScore used to prioritize history completion.
problem.existingGoodControl: 20-day sector peer return already excludes the candidate before computing sectorReturn20; this is the precedent to extend rather than redesign.

frozenSemantics.inclusiveState: Current production-equivalent sector state including candidate.
frozenSemantics.leaveOneOutState: Same sector state recomputed after removing candidate symbol from the effective-dated member set.
membershipRequirements: classificationSchemeId and membershipVersion must identify the decision-time taxonomy.
membership must be effective at scanDate and known by decisionTimestamp.
candidate exclusion is by exact symbol identity before aggregation.
later reclassification cannot be backfilled into historical receipts.
frozenSemantics.globalNormalizerRule: For candidate-specific leave-one-out sectorScore, recompute max sector amount after removing the candidate from its own sector; otherwise self-contribution can remain inside the normalization denominator.
unknownRules: If no peer remains, leave-one-out sector state is UNKNOWN, never 0.
If no history-ready peer remains for the 20-day amount denominator, leave-one-out activity is UNKNOWN.
One-peer diagnostics may be reported but must carry SMALL_N_SENSITIVE and are not automatically eligible for Formal use.
Missing classification vintage or ambiguous membership fails closed.

requiredDiagnostics: activityDelta = inclusiveAmountVs20D - looAmountVs20D when both known
rankDelta and Top6 membership difference under common-support diagnostic replay
warmupPriorityDelta for candidates whose history admission depends on sectorScore

adversarialCounterexample.lesson: The candidate can simultaneously flip the sector hard gate and add more than ten priority-score points through its own same-day contribution in an extreme but mathematically valid case.

researchDecision.recommendedUse: Research-only diagnostics first. Compare current inclusive production-equivalent state against leave-one-out state without changing live A/B, sector gate, ranking, Top6, weights or capital.
researchDecision.d16Requirement: D16 must evaluate common-support rank/selection effects and residual incrementality before any promotion or replacement.
